fields.acceptance_criteria: 1. session-api writes the planned session directory and JSON files to disk. 2. The persisted manifest and transcript use stable JSON structures. 3. IO and serialization failures surface through explicit session-api errors. 4. cargo test -p session-api covers file creation and persisted content shape.
